evals.name: irsa-secret-read
evals.prompt: orders 서비스용 IRSA role이랑 Secrets Manager 읽기 정책 테라폼으로 추가해줘 (terragrunt 레포)
evals.expected_output: Follows the repo layout with one terragrunt.hcl per environment and resource; policy owned by the orders directory; Sid names the feature; policy description is a complete English sentence without slash or parentheses; issue key and description tags, with the unknown issue key asked for instead of invented; plan and apply not run; terragrunt hcl fmt --check and terragrunt hcl validate listed, never hclfmt.

evals.name: karpenter-interruption
evals.prompt: EKS에 Karpenter 붙이면서 spot interruption 처리까지 테라폼으로 구성해줘
evals.expected_output: Uses the terraform-aws-modules eks karpenter submodule with enable_spot_termination; queue_name output feeds settings.interruptionQueue; eks-pod-identity-agent add-on present; karpenter.sh/discovery only on subnet and security group tags; no Node Termination Handler; AL2023 or Bottlerocket AMI; NodePool and EC2NodeClass YAML left to k8s-manifest; plan and apply left to the user.

evals.name: remove-unused-role
evals.prompt: settlement 서비스 IRSA role 이제 안 쓰니까 테라폼에서 리소스 정리해줘 (terragrunt 레포)
evals.expected_output: Does not run destroy without an explicit request; hands the exact terragrunt destroy command for each environment's unit to the user first; deletes the terragrunt.hcl files only after destroy is confirmed, never before; dependents that reference the role are checked.

evals.name: new-s3-backend
evals.prompt: 신규 프로젝트 테라폼 백엔드 구성해줘. 스테이트 버킷이랑 CI가 쓸 백엔드 IAM role 정책까지 같이 (terragrunt 레포, AWS)
evals.expected_output: S3 backend with use_lockfile = true and encrypt = true; required_version >= 1.10.0; state bucket has versioning enabled; no DynamoDB lock table and no dynamodb_table argument; the backend role policy allows get, put, and delete on the .tflock object next to the state key; plan and apply not run.

evals.name: migrate-off-dynamodb-lock
evals.prompt: 지금 백엔드가 S3 + DynamoDB 락 테이블 쓰는데 DynamoDB 걷어내고 싶어. 테라폼 코드 수정해줘 (terragrunt 레포)
evals.expected_output: Sets use_lockfile = true while keeping dynamodb_table for one apply, then removes the argument and the table in a second change; never a single change that drops DynamoDB locking before S3 locking is live; the backend role gains get, put, and delete on the .tflock object; required_version >= 1.10.0; plan, apply, and the table destroy are left to the user.

evals.name: tgw-sg-referencing
evals.prompt: orders EKS 노드에서 shared 계정 VPC에 있는 RDS 5432 접근 허용하는 SG 인바운드 룰 추가해줘. 두 VPC는 RAM으로 공유된 TGW로 연결돼 있어
evals.expected_output: Uses aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule with referenced_security_group_id pointing at the orders node security group, never the orders VPC or subnet CIDR; checks security_group_referencing_support is enabled on the transit gateway and both VPC attachments, and treats enabling it as a separate earlier change; rule description names the source workload; no inline ingress blocks; plan and apply not run.
